content.text: Banana Ball: June 18-20, 2026 — First Horizon Park Back Book An Event Cosmic Baseball: May 22-23, 2026 Banana Ball: June 18-20, 2026 Calendar Weddings Back Park History SULPHUR DELL First Horizon Back Safety Policies How To Get Here Buy Tickets BANANA BALLParty Animals vs. Texas TailgatersJune 18-20, 2026 Banana Ball is coming back to First Horizon Park! GROUP HOSPITALITY SPACES ARE NOW AVAILABLE Group Ticket information What is Banana Ball? We will let them explain. Banana Ball is bringing back their “World Famous Baseball Circus” to First Horizon Park June 18-20, 2026 for three nights of epic performances and baseball. In addition to the cast of characters, dancers, performers, mascots, and musicians, the Bananas are bringing their own twist of baseball to First Horizon Park with independent professional players on their rosters. Coming to First Horizon Park in 2026 are the Party Animals and Texas Tailgaters. Join the Ticket Lottery A clear bag policy will also be enforced to reduce the need for security to inspect the belongings of guests. View First Horizon Park’s Health and Safety protocols.
